points.description: States the answer FALSE (the OS does not execute the next instruction after the faulting one).
points.partial_credit: Half if the answer is false but with no or wrong reasoning given, or reasoning correct but verdict unclear.

points.description: Explains that after the handler creates the mapping, it returns and re-executes the faulting instruction (the PC is not incremented/advanced past it).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says the instruction is retried or the PC is not moved, without clearly saying the faulting instruction is re-executed.

rubric.notes: Full marks: FALSE plus the reason that the faulting instruction is re-executed because the PC is not incremented after the handler returns. Part marks: correct verdict with vague or missing reason, or a correct reason with an unclear verdict. A TRUE answer earns 0 on both points.
